outcome: Time interval from labor induction to delivery
cohort: 86 term pregnant patients (37-41 weeks of gestation) who experienced pre-labour amniotic membrane rupture
finding: Maternal serum hs-CRP levels during PROM were not significantly different between vaginal and abdominal deliveries and were not predictive of successful labor induction.
mod_finding: High serum hs-CRP levels were not significantly correlated with the probability of cesarean delivery in term pregnancies with pre-labor rupture of the membranes.
